# Cycle

> A local-first period tracking PWA built on @niclaslindstedt/oss-framework.
> One report per day — four yes/no answers (blood, mood swings, lust, sex) plus
> an optional waking temperature and ovulation-test result — stored
> on-device as JSON, with an optional copy synced to the user's own
> Dropbox or Google Drive. Cycles, averages, and the next-period forecast are
> derived from those reports at read time; nothing about a cycle is stored.

- App: https://cycle.niclaslindstedt.se/
- Source: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/period
- Framework: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/oss-framework

## Features

- Daily report: blood, mood swings, lust and sex as yes/no, plus an optional
  waking temperature and fertility-test result, for a date that defaults
  to today; the whole screen fits a phone without scrolling
- Forecast: cycle day, predicted next period, and an optional fertile window,
  with a stated confidence rather than a bare date
- History: average cycle and period length, cycle-length trend, mood swings by
  cycle phase, and the list of periods behind the averages
- Settings: light/dark theme, cycle assumptions, cloud sync, JSON backup and
  restore
- No account, no server, no analytics; installable and fully offline
